label: The encyclopedia workshop
title: Every source can help the wiki grow.
description: A detail, a documented image, a story to expand: choose where to start, then follow your proposal through review.

steps.title: Explore
steps.body: Find a saga, place, item or work and open its entry.

steps.title: Document
steps.body: Identify the volume, chapter, page or official publication supporting your correction.

steps.title: Propose
steps.body: The entry’s correction button saves your text as a proposal for review.

steps.title: Keep it alive
steps.body: Find the decision and reviewer’s note in your proposals. Accepted corrections are credited.

workshopsUnavailable: Workshops are temporarily unavailable. You can still suggest a correction from an entry.
